verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Discord servers organize conversation into channels, with threads that branch off a channel and private threads available to all servers (discord-docs-37, discord-docs-38). Gateway events reference channel updates and role creation, which implies channel and role structures (discord-docs-20), and community evidence notes channels can be age-restricted (discord-comm-2). Missing for 10: explicit docs on public vs. private channels, documentation of channel permission/membership controls for admins, role-based access configuration details, independent hands-on corroboration.
